h1: Romme Alpin ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Romme Alpin is the closest large ski area to Stockholm, a low hill outside Borlänge with 34 runs and 275 metres of vertical. Six of its fourteen lifts are six-seat express chairs, which is why the queues move on a Saturday when half of Stockholm has driven up.
stayOverview: Most people ski Romme as a day trip. If you do stay, Borlänge twenty minutes away has the hotel rooms rather than the mountain itself.
hotelIntro: Book in Borlänge rather than at the hill: Romme is a day area, and the beds are in town.
rentalCars: A car is the normal way here. Romme is about two and a half hours from Stockholm and twenty minutes from Borlänge.
